name: DB107S
title: DB101S to DB107S: 1 A single-phase glass-passivated bridge rectifiers, 50 V to 1000 V, DBS surface-mount package
summary: A family of seven single-phase full-wave bridge rectifiers built from four glass-passivated diodes in a molded DBS surface-mount body. They carry 1.0 A average output and take a 30 A single half-sine surge; the seven grades differ only in reverse voltage rating, from 50 V (DB101S) to 1000 V (DB107S). Forward drop is 1.1 V maximum per leg at 1 A.

operation.text: Four diodes form a full-wave bridge. Each AC pin (3 and 4) feeds the + pin (1) through one diode and is fed from the - pin (2) through another, so either polarity of AC input appears as positive at pin 1 with respect to pin 2.

The ratings apply at 25 °C ambient with single-phase half-wave 60 Hz operation into a resistive or inductive load. For a capacitive load, the current is derated by 20 %. Forward voltage and the curves for forward current, reverse current and capacitance are given per diode (per leg, per bridge element).
Full 1.0 A average output is allowed up to 40 °C ambient with the part mounted on 13 mm × 13 mm copper pads; above that the allowed current falls linearly to zero at 150 °C.
The 30 A rating is for one 8.3 ms half sine. Over repeated cycles at 60 Hz the allowed peak falls, to about 12 A at 100 cycles.
The diodes are glass passivated. The package is RoHS compliant and meant for printed circuit boards.
